zh: 國防部：17架次中國軍機越臺海中線
en: Taiwan reports 17 Chinese military aircraft sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line.

zh: 民航局規劃離島加班機20架次，11月20日起開放訂位
en: Taiwan CAA plans 20 extra island flight operations, with bookings set for Nov. 20.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：CoolFly Aircraft稱Dream ST電動飛行器已準備交付、印度航空檢討成本 研議與印度快運航空加強合作、Embraer 與 Envoy Air 延長 E-Jet 客機重度維修協議
en: Aviation briefs: CoolFly Aircraft Says Dream ST Electric Aircraft Is Ready for Delivery; Air India reviews costs and considers closer cooperation with Air India Express; Embraer and Envoy Air extend heavy maintenance agreement for E-Jet aircraft

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Embraer 公佈荷蘭產業合作進度 籌備 C-390 運輸機隊支援、宿霧太平洋航空接收今年第六架新機 A320neo 自天津飛抵馬尼拉、Ascendance 展出全尺寸 ATEA 混合電力垂直起降航空器原型
en: Aviation briefs: Embraer reports Dutch industrial cooperation progress and C-390 support preparations; Cebu Pacific takes delivery of its sixth aircraft of 2026, an Airbus A320neo; Ascendance unveils full-scale ATEA hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft prototype

zh: 航空短訊彙整：伊拉克航空出售停放突尼西亞逾30年的兩架波音747、Archer 與迪士尼啟動航空研究合作 展示 Midnight 主題塗裝、法國與瑞典完成雙邊航空演習 Rafale 與 Gripen 共同參演
en: Aviation briefs: Iraqi Airways offers two Boeing 747s stored in Tunisia for direct sale; Archer and Disney Imagineering begin aviation research collaboration and show themed Midnight aircraft; France and Sweden complete first air exercise under bilateral deterrence framework

zh: 航空短訊彙整：好萊塢伯班克機場塔臺一度無人值勤 飛行員以無線電協調降落、波音 B-1B 轟炸機升級案通過關鍵設計審查、美業者簽意向書 擬建250英里超音速測試走廊
en: Aviation briefs: Hollywood Burbank tower loses controller coverage; pilots coordinate arrivals by radio; Boeing’s B-1B bomber upgrade clears critical design review; US Firms Partner to Develop 250-Mile Supersonic Test Corridor

zh: 航空短訊彙整：捷藍航空將從羅德岱堡開航大開曼及宏都拉斯 每日各一班、美國陸軍以無人地面載具發射18架無人機、土耳其接收首批三架 Baykar Kızılelma 無人戰機
en: Aviation briefs: JetBlue to add daily Fort Lauderdale flights to Grand Cayman and Honduras; US Army unmanned ground vehicle launches 18-drone swarm; Türkiye receives first three Baykar Kızılelma uncrewed fighter jets

zh: 航空短訊彙整：SkyWest 將 CRJ200 改為41座 CRJ450 首架預計年底前投入聯航支線、阿拉斯加與夏威夷航空機師12月投票 決定首份共同團體協約、韓華系統首獲美國雷達訂單 將供應反無人機試點
en: Aviation briefs: SkyWest expects first 41-seat CRJ450 for United Express by year-end; Alaska and Hawaiian pilots to vote on joint contract in December; Hanwha Systems wins first U.S. radar order for a drone-detection pilot

zh: 華航連11年獲APEX五星肯定 首獲座椅舒適度獎
en: China Airlines reports its 11th straight APEX five-star honor and first seat comfort award.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Rostec宣佈向俄羅斯航太軍交付新一批Su-57戰機、聯合航空713架飛機已裝 Starlink 支線機佔352架、泰雷茲以三地據點服務亞太航空業 看重本地備料與長約
en: Aviation briefs: Rostec announces another Su-57 fighter delivery to the Russian Aerospace Forces; United installs Starlink on 713 aircraft, including 352 regional jets; Thales outlines three-hub strategy for Asia-Pacific airline maintenance
